player_prompt.intro:
Kaɗa Dimmo {player_id} a cikin Nim.
Burinku shi ne ka ɗauki na ƙarshe da suka rage.
A kowace guje, zaɓi takaice ɓangare ɗaya kuma kaɗɗi ɗaya ko fiye alaaɓe daga ciki.
Amfani da tsarin '[pile quantity]', inda ɓangare shi ne lambar ɓangare kuma adadi shi ne adadin alaaɓe za kaɗɗi.
Misali, '[0 3]' yaɗɗi alaaɓe 3 daga ɓangare 0.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Walaa format je ɗon naftirta. Naftor "[pile quantity]".
invalid_move.correct_format_wrong_fields: To'otoo {player_id}, lakke wakkatiire ndaaraa. Kolom {col} e woylaa.
invalid_move.non_positive: Haani itta ko ɓuri kuje go'o.
invalid_move.exceeds_pile: Aƴan kawo {quantity} daga ɓangare {pile_index} (komi {pile_count} suka rage).

observation.removed_from_piles: Toɓo {player_id} tefi [{pile_index} {quantity}], o ari {quantity} koɗe e wuro {pile_index}.
